title: site-sidebar-tree — the site's own left sidebar becomes the tree: persistent, resizable, deep, the desktop shell

set.request: The site sidebar renders the tree: persistent, resizable, deep, the desktop shell (core/Sidebar consumes ux/Tree; resize + remember + reset; workspace note decided; docs)
steps: rows via Tree.from + tree_nodes() back-compat, delete nav()/group()/link()
resize: track+rail, grab handle, --sidebar-w clamp, store, reset
docs pass: readme, decisions, other doc/*.md
verify on :8118 headless: stability measurement, crawl, shots
set.outcome:
**The site sidebar renders `ux/Tree`, resizes and remembers its width, sticky in its own track — and the owner's "predefined workspaces" question got an answer without a build.** Stability: 0px x/width/row-y drift across 5 page switches + a content scroll, at 1280/1920/3440. Crawl: 80/80 checks pass (20 pages × 400/1280/1920/3440), 0 console errors, every first-level group present, current page marked. Resize proven end to end: drag survives a reload, double-click reset survives a reload back to default. Default width: **20em** (241/256/288px at 1280/1920/3440, up from 229/243/274px — larger at every width, most at 3440) — `rem` was tried first and measured a flat 288px everywhere (this site's fluid scale lives on `body`, not `html`), caught before landing. 69 lines of hand-rolled list-building code removed (`nav()`/`group()`/`link()` in Sidebar.js, `.sidebar-link`/`.sidebar-group*` in Sidebar.css); `ux/Tree` draws every row now, demoed live and five levels deep on the module's own page. What's left: the six production call sites (`framework/page.js` and five others) still pass `pages:`, not `root:` — they render through the tree today with zero edits, but the deep reach needs one line each, outside this fence (`core/Page` has another minion in it); spelled out in doc/decisions.md.

Before (1920): 243px · After (1920): 256px
Before (3440): 274px · After (3440): 288px

Links:
- [Sidebar overview](/framework/core/Sidebar/) — the live tree demo, five levels, drag the edge
- [Decisions](/framework/core/Sidebar/doc/decisions/) — the 2026-09-18 section: the tree, the em/rem bug, the workspace-note verdict
- [Placement](/framework/core/Sidebar/doc/placement/) · [Narrow](/framework/core/Sidebar/doc/narrow/) · [Views](/framework/core/Sidebar/doc/views/)

Left open, with reasons:
- The 6 production call sites' one-line `root:` swap — outside the fence.
- `ux/Tree` has no `leaf: true` awareness — logged for that module's own backlog, not fixable here.
- `$rail` is an unread handle, same shape `$bar`/`$menu` were before this task dropped them — one more line, noted in doc/views.md.
